name: B10-0429/2026 (ESN) – The need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text:
**What it asks for:** This is a resolution from a right-wing group in the European Parliament, not a law. It calls on member states to fight "Islamism" and what it calls the influence network of the Muslim Brotherhood. It asks governments to check who funds mosques, schools and associations, to refuse entry to foreign preachers who incite hatred, and to consider adding the Muslim Brotherhood to the EU terrorist list. It also asks the Commission to report on EU funding given to the youth group FEMYSO.

**Key points:**
- Member states should tighten checks on funding, staff and foreign money behind religious and community groups.
- The Commission should publish what EU money and access FEMYSO and similar groups received.
- The Council should consider listing the Muslim Brotherhood as a terrorist organisation.
